biggest_gap.title: The print layout base prints the keyboard focus ring: a keyboard user's printout carries a 2 px blue outline on whatever control had the focus
biggest_gap.detail: The shell is keyboard-first, so a user nearly always has the focus on a control when they press Ctrl+P or pick 'Print this screen'. The print stylesheet does not turn focus styling off. In print media the focused element keeps its 'solid 2px rgb(26,115,232)' outline, so the printed Arabic users list shows a blue box around a column header ('آخر تسجيل دخول' in 07-print-users-ar.jpg). This print base is what every later report will use: invoices, delivery notes and statements a UAE trading company hands to customers. A visible UI artefact on those documents makes them look unfinished, and Odoo's printed reports do not carry one. Everything else in the piece holds: every gate caught every plant, and ours beats Odoo on all four compared tasks. Fix: in the shared print stylesheet, set outline: none and box-shadow: none on :focus and :focus-visible, and blur nothing (the focus must come back after printing). Add a unit or e2e check that, under print media, the focused element has no outline, in English and Arabic.
biggest_gap.evidence: In the demo (./erp up), sign in as admin.ar@alnoor.example. Press G then U, press Tab 6 times (the focus lands on the 'الاسم' header), then print. drivers/print-focus.cjs emulates print media and reports {"focused":"الاسم","outlineInPrintMedia":"solid 2px rgb(26, 115, 232)"} (print-focus.json). It also wrote print-users-ar-after-keyboard.pdf through Chromium's print to PDF. 07-print-users-ar.jpg shows the outline on the printed header. web/src/styles.css has four '@media print' blocks (lines 1043, 1106, 1149, plus lists.css 623 and forms.css 273), and none of them mentions outline or :focus.
